remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -DWINVER=0x600)

remove_definitions(-D_CRT_NON_CONFORMING_SWPRINTFS)

add_definitions(
    -D_WINE
    -D_CRYPT32_
)

spec2def(crypt32.dll crypt32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# crypt32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/crypt32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(crypt32_shims OBJECT base64.c cert.c chain.c collectionstore.c context.c crl.c ctl.c decode.c encode.c filestore.c main.c message.c msg.c object.c oid.c pfx.c proplist.c protectdata.c provstore.c regstore.c rootstore.c serialize.c sip.c store.c str.c reactos/store.c reactos/unixlib.c)
target_link_libraries(crypt32_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libbcrypt libuser32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32_vista libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(crypt32_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro
add_cargo_module(crypt32 crypt32-cargo crypt32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS crypt32_shims psdk)
